column1: # ci/sibling-pins.tsv — the ONE source for the sibling repositories every zenmetrics build
# clones next to the workspace (path dependencies and [patch.crates-io] targets).
# Read by:  scripts/ci/clone-siblings.sh  (every ci.yml job's clone step, and lock.sh)
#           scripts/ci/lock.sh            (--check / --regen of Cargo.lock in an isolated snapshot)
#           scripts/safe_push.sh          (refuses a Cargo.lock / pin change that fails lock.sh --check)
# Do NOT copy these revisions anywhere else; change them HERE.
# Columns (tab-separated): name  url  dest  rev  flags
#   dest  — path relative to the zenmetrics workspace root (the repo checkout)
#   rev   — full commit sha (must be reachable from a branch of the remote)
#   flags — comma list; `sparse-no-benchmarks` = sparse checkout without /benchmarks/ (NTFS-invalid
#           file names) and core.protectNTFS=false for the checkout; `-` = none
# The zenpixels 0.5 / zencodec 0.3 / zenmeta 0.2 cohort (zenpixels, zencodec,
# zensim, fast-ssim2, zenresize, zenjpeg, zenpng, zenwebp, zengif, zenavif,
# ultrahdr, heic, zenbitmaps, zenextras, jxl-encoder, zenjxl, garb,
# linear-srgb) is pinned directly by GitHub rev in Cargo.toml / [patch.crates-io]
# so no sibling clones are needed for those repos. Only the remaining non-cohort
# path-dependency siblings stay here.
# EVERY pin below must resolve `cargo metadata --locked` against the
# committed Cargo.lock.
# crates/zenfleet-vastai optional `source-features` dep (`../../../zenanalyze`)
# and workspace [patch.crates-io].
zenanalyze
# Workspace [patch.crates-io] (`../../butteraugli/butteraugli`) and
# benchmarks/heaptrack/drivers/cpu_profile direct path dep.
butteraugli
# zenmetrics-cli optional `hdr-svt` feature path dep (`../../../zenav1-svt/rust/svtav1`).
zenav1-svt
# zenmetrics-cli optional `hdr` feature path dep (`../../../zenflate`)
# and workspace [patch.crates-io].
zenflate
# zenmetrics-cli optional `avif-aom` feature path deps
# (`../../../zenav1-aom/crates/{aom-bench,aom-sys-ref,aom-dsp}`).
zenav1-aom
